notes: The repository contains TLE epochs but no verified per-record publication or first-availability timestamps.
Do not treat TLE epoch as proof that a record was available to an operator at that time.
Update this manifest only when supported by a source record, archive metadata, or a reproducible retrieval log.
Space-Track GP_HISTORY CREATION_DATE values are retained as diagnostic source-record timestamps only; they do not establish operator receipt or first availability.
